purpose: Prevent material, lighting-probe, transform or renderer-state discontinuities when DanchiHighDetail cross-fades from physical source renderers to LOD1/2/3 proxies. This is implementation/runtime readiness QA only and awards no Visual Fidelity points without native rendered evidence.

sourceClassificationPolicy.rationale: The 340 mm clothes-pole support arm remains facade-depth silhouette geometry after the smaller receiver and mounting hardware become sub-pixel.

failureInjection: move one LOD proxy by more than 0.5 mm and require FAIL before formal capture
replace one proxy mesh or material and require FAIL
change one proxy reflection/light-probe policy or probe anchor and require FAIL
clear a source-derived proxy MaterialPropertyBlock while the source retains one and require FAIL
change a proxy motion-vector/occlusion/sorting state and require FAIL
classify HD_ClothesBracket_* only through LOD1 and require FAIL through the clothes-hardware closure/LOD policy
leave any declared LOD renderer outside its canonical HD_LOD1/2/3_Proxy root and require FAIL
